claims.statement: The master research archive maps every EARTH_ROOT_D_V1 locked decision (15 operator selections + 7 frozen parameters) and every phase output P01-P32 to its module, tests, receipt, and communications/decision record, including the acceptance matrix and the source-origin/physical NOT_CLAIMED posture.

negative_results: This is a traceability/documentation phase: it establishes provenance and claims nothing physical or source-validated.
Corrections and failed codecs are preserved in the archive (legacy bare-refusal migration, unaddressable-cell honest residuals, preserved ambiguity as alias sets, foreign-body out-of-scope typing).
P32 (release/version ritual, SHA-256 manifest generation) is out of scope for this tranche and authored by the release lead; no version bump, tag, or commit is performed here.
T07 receipts P25-P28 are authored by the T07 tranche; the archive references those modules and their verdicts, which are present and importable.
privacy_check: CLEAN - the archive references opaque ids (STONEHENGE_PRIVATE_001) and synthetic/public artifacts only; no private path literals, no identity tokens, no raw private vectors or narrative
